0022600197.text: The Lakers (8-2) are 1st in the Pacific and 3rd in the West, riding a four-game winning streak after going 8-2 in their last ten, while the Pistons (6-2) are 1st in the Central and 3rd in the East and come off a one-game losing streak. Luka Doncic is day-to-day with a back injury and is a game-time decision for Los Angeles, while Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Lakers lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 113-110 in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
